listing.name: Legend of Legaia — legend-of-legaia-re (AndrewAltimit)
listing.summary: Upstream reports automated controller-driven tests from New Game to credits, covering scenes, battles, menus and minigames. Matching the retail game is still in progress, and some unidentified sound effects use substitutes. Portcove has not confirmed a complete playthrough. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SCUS-94254 BIN or CUE. The engine reads the original data while playing. Other regions may extract, but the engine and patcher target USA. Whole-image hashes can vary with the dumping method.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the README for platform archives containing legaia-engine and its supporting tools. Open the engine or desktop app, select your own disc and choose Play. Browser play reads the image locally. A source build uses cargo build --release with Rust edition 2024. The asset viewer and Studio are tools, not separate game ports.

warnings: Upstream reports automated controller-driven tests from New Game to credits, covering scenes, battles, menus and minigames. Matching the retail game is still in progress, and some unidentified sound effects use substitutes. Portcove has not confirmed a complete playthrough.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
